panels.label: forward (nothing saved)

kernels.name: LayerNorm + projection
code: mean, rstd = statistics of the row (fp32, quad shuffles on the registers)
n = bf16((x - mean) · rstd · γ)           # the mma operand
out = n @ W.T                             # mma.sync, W from shared memory, fp32 accumulation

training.title: A100 · layer_norm_linear · training · bf16, d_norm 16 / 64 / 128 / 256 / 384, 1 - 16 outputs

panels.label: forward (saves mean / rstd and the fp32 result u)

kernels.name: LayerNorm + projection (saving)
code: mean, rstd = statistics of the row (fp32)
u = ((x - mean) · rstd · γ) @ W.T         # fp32, before rounding

panels.hbm_title: HBM (sizes at the token pair, L = 768, d_norm 384, 16 outputs)

panels.label: backward (one pass over x)

kernels.name: dx and the weight-gradient partials
code: dxn = dout @ W;   s1 = dout · (W γ);   s2 = dout · u
dx = rstd (dxn γ - s1 / D - x̂ s2 / D)     # x̂ rebuilt from x, mean, rstd
Gn_partial += doutᵀ @ x̂                   # mma over the rows, summed per CTA in shared memory

kernels.name: LayerNorm-scale gradient
code: dγ[c] = Σ_h W[h, c] · Gn[h, c]
